Women's Monday Mountain Bike Ride

Harrisonburg, VA · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendlyNo-drop

Women's Monday Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Harrisonburg, VA. It rolls every Monday at 5:30 pm from Massanutten Western Slope parking lot. About 4–6 miles, beginner, frequent stops. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner, frequent stops. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Women's Monday Mountain Bike Ride group ride

A super casual no-drop trail ride for women on the Western Slope singletrack. Four to six miles of dirt and rock at a beginner pace with plenty of stops. Sign the Coalition's online waiver first; ride leaders can sort you out with a trail parking pass.
